debrief db-021

4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-l-l-e-c-t-e-d r-e-l-o-c-a-t-e-d p-a-r-c-e-l-s w-i-t-h-i-n t-w-e-l-v-e m-i-n-u-t-e-s o-f t-h-e f-o-r-c-e-d d-o-w-n-g-r-a-d-e-s, s-t-o-r-i-n-g t-h-e-m i-n a s-h-i-e-l-d-e-d c-o-n-t-a-i-n-e-r, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-e-d i-n-t-e-r-v-e-n-t-i-o-n l-o-g
